description: A three-band mixer: it splits the input into low, medium and high and gives each band its own level with its own modulation.

params.text: How much the HIGH jack moves the high band's level.
Level of the high band, from silence to a small boost.
Level of the medium band, from silence to a small boost.
How much the MED jack moves the medium band's level.
Level of the low band, from silence to a small boost.
How much the LOW jack moves the low band's level.
This switch is not read by the module; nothing on the panel changes with it.

inputs.text: Moves the high band's level, by as much as the MOD knob beside HIGH allows.
Moves the medium band's level, by as much as the MOD knob beside MEDIUM allows.
Takes the equaliser out of circuit while it is high, passing the inputs straight to the outputs.
Moves the low band's level, by as much as the MOD knob beside LOW allows.
Audio into the right side. Left unpatched, the left input is used on both sides.

outputs.text: The three bands mixed back together, right side.
The three bands mixed back together, left side.

notes: Set Rack's sample rate to 96kHz before using this module. At any other rate it runs at the wrong speed, and a red bar appears across the bottom of the panel saying so.
An unpatched modulation CV jack does not read 0V: the firmware drives it from an internal chaotic generator, so a MOD knob turned up with nothing patched lets a wandering voltage through.
